dedupe_keys.name: edcs dataset of building energy with different courtyard shapes kuala lumpur

description: EDCS is a tabular dataset of 8,538 building cases giving heating, cooling and total energy loads for buildings next to enclosed courtyards of L, O and U shape in the tropical climate of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It was prepared by Abdulbasit Almhafdy of Qassim University and Ashjan Aljbreen for predicting and optimising building energy use from courtyard design, for sustainable urban design research and for teaching. Each row describes one building by width, length, height, orientation, window ratio, form factor and surface-to-volume ratio, with its cooling, heating and total load. Access: version 5.0 was published on Zenodo on 23 March 2025 from the GitHub repository. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the loads come from parametric simulation of generic forms, not from metered buildings, and the simulation tool and settings are documented only in the repository. Simulation uses are training surrogate models and optimising courtyard and building geometry for cooling energy in hot-humid cities. Related records: besos (surrogate modelling of building energy) and archetypal.
